ja:grammar:です: Is, am, are. Ends a polite sentence saying what something is.
ja:grammar:は: Marks the topic, the thing you are talking about. Roughly "as for".
ja:grammar:か: Turns a sentence into a question. Like a spoken question mark.
ja:grammar:の: Links two nouns, like 's or "of". The first noun owns or describes the second.
ja:grammar:じゃありません: Is not, am not, are not. The polite negative of です.
ja:grammar:も: Also, too. Says the same is true of this as well.
ja:grammar:があります: There is, or I have. Used for things, not people or animals.
ja:grammar:がいます: There is, or I have. Used for people and animals.
ja:grammar:に: Marks where something is (in, at, on), when something happens (at, on), or where you are going (to).
ja:grammar:にへ: To. Marks the place you are going.
ja:grammar:を: Object marker. Marks the thing the action is done to.
ja:grammar:で: At, in. Marks the place where an action happens.
ja:grammar:と: And, between nouns. Also "with" a person.
ja:grammar:ます: Polite verb ending. Says you do something, or will do it.
ja:grammar:ません: Polite negative verb ending. Says you do not do something, or will not.
ja:grammar:ました: Polite past verb ending. Says you did something.
ja:grammar:ませんか: Won't you? Would you like to? A polite invitation to do something.
ja:grammar:て-form: The linking form of a verb. It is the form that goes before ください to ask for something.
ja:grammar:てください: Please do. Politely asks someone to do something.
ja:grammar:い-adjective: A describing word ending in い. It goes straight before a noun, or before です.
ja:grammar:な-adjective: A describing word that takes な before a noun. Before です there is no な.
ja:grammar:がすきです: I like. The thing you like comes before が.
ja:grammar:stem-たいです: I want to. Goes on the end of a verb to say what you want to do.
